label: Sungai Petani bakery fire

sequence: Insulation failure within the motor of the spiral dough mixer; short circuiting and overheating of its windings
Fire spreads to the timber shelving and packaging, then across the production area, burning through part of the ground floor ceiling
Smoke and soot throughout the ground floor and lower staircase

gates.name: Period of insurance
gates.reason: Loss on 14 September 2024 falls inside 1 March 2024 to 28 February 2025.

gates.name: Peril insured
gates.reason: Proximate cause: fire, started by an electrical fault in the mixer motor, with no intervening event; the mixer's own damage is from the fault. Fire is the base insured peril. No Condition 6 exclusion engaged: an accidental electrical fire, not atmospheric, seismic, war, riot or terrorism.

gates.name: Conditions precedent
gates.reason: Notice on 15 September 2024; written claim delivered 25 September 2024, day 11 of 15.

gates.name: Endorsement held
gates.reason: No endorsement required for fire. FP508A.01 is on the schedule and is tested at item level; FP508B is not held.

gates.name: Endorsement satisfied
gates.reason: No warranties. Condition 9 not engaged: trade unchanged; closing overnight is not unoccupancy; the Insured remains registered proprietor, and the claimant lodges under his written authorisation.

gates.name: Item admitted
gates.reason: Five of six items admitted. The spiral dough mixer (ref 2), the machine in which the electrical fault began, is excluded by FP508A.01; its proviso keeps the oven, proofer and worktables (ref 3) damaged by the fire it set up. Condition 20 average on Item 2 only (factor 0.75), applied after the exclusion. Nil excess for the fire peril.

quotes.text: if the Property Insured described in the said Schedule or any part of such property be destroyed or damaged by FIRE or LIGHTNING

during the Period of Insurance stated in the Schedule or of any subsequent period in respect of which the Insured shall have paid and the Company shall have accepted the premium required for the renewal of this Policy

This Company is expressly declared to be free from liability for loss of or damage to, any electrical machine, apparatus, or any portion of the electrical installation arising from or occasioned by over-running, excessive pressure, short-circuiting, self heating, arcing or leakage of electricity from whatever cause (lightning included) arising.

Provided that this exemption shall only apply to the particular electrical machine, apparatus, or portion of the electrical installation so affected, and not to other machines, apparatus or electrical installation destroyed or damaged by fire set up by such particular machine, apparatus or other electrical installation.

If the property hereby insured shall, at the breaking out of any fire, be collectively of greater value than the sum insured thereon, then the Insured shall be considered as being his own Insurer for the difference, and shall bear a rateable proportion of the loss accordingly. Every item, if more than one, of the Policy shall be separately subject to this Condition.

facts.fact: Fire began at the spiral dough mixer: insulation failure within its motor; the motor's own damage is from the fault, not external burning.
facts.source: Adjuster's report, Investigation, Cause and origin and Reports relied on

facts.fact: Oven, proofer and worktables damaged by the fire spreading from the mixer; no pre-existing defect in wiring or other machines.
